RECOMMENDATION: accept p0b on the zero-new-debt basis and route a config-only fix to the SN4 owner — add three naming-lint.json {file,owner,reason} exceptions mirroring the existing public-export-subpath barrel exceptions. Do NOT rename them: renaming a public export subpath breaks the @alembic/core/* consumer contract and ripples into Alembic/Plugin/Agent. Needs controller decision because it edits governance config + files outside this demand's authority.
